label: EUTHYPHRO_HORN_1: literal horns, approved because good or good because approved
definition: [EUTHYPHRO_HORN_1] In a DependenceFrame, literal horn 1 ApprovedBecauseGood says God's approving depends for what it is on goodness; literal horn 2 GoodBecauseApproved says goodness depends for what it is on God's approving. LiteralHornsCover is their disjunction. Literal horn 1 does not by itself say that goodness is distinct from God.
note: Analyst formulation of the dilemma's literal question; attribution deferred (Plato, Euthyphro 10a is an unread lead). The identity model satisfies literal horn 1.
